reason: Recipe step names and their JSON property names change (e.g. ResetIndexProfile/RebuildIndexProfile → ResetIndex/RebuildIndex, IndexIds/Indexes → IndexNames) without any backward-compatible aliasing, so existing recipes or deployment plans built against these step names will silently stop matching and no longer execute on upgrade.
